title: Imported workouts moved to another day before the duplicate fix still come back twice on a re-import
what: A later update made the app remember where an imported Hevy or Strong workout first sat, so moving it to another day and importing the same file again no longer brings it back. That memory is only written when a workout is moved after the update. A member who moved imported workouts to another day on an older version has nothing remembered for them, so the next re-import of the same file adds those workouts a second time, with their sets counted twice in kg lifted and records.
expected: Workouts moved before the fix are recognised too (for example by matching the file's workout to one with the same name, length and sets on any day), or the re-import names the likely copies before adding them.
how_often: rare: only members who imported, moved a workout to another day on an older version, then import the same file again
fix_line: Also match a re-imported workout to one already here by name, length and sets when its start is unknown

items.reason: Fresh install and update run the same step-by-step database update: every change only adds empty columns or new tables, each step is skipped if already there, and the version is stamped last, so a phone killed mid-update finishes next launch and any older version can update straight to the newest. Speed indexes and one-time record repairs run outside that versioned step so existing installs get them. Erase keeps the update stamps. An older backup restores; a newer one is refused with plain words. A workout in progress saved by an older version reopens (missing fields fall back), and saved settings have their own version and repair. Known faults reused: an unreadable saved workout is dropped, photos stay behind on a new phone. Sideload vs Play package, watch-and-phone versions and panel cache are not in this area (no package, watch or web code here).

Days are stored as YYYY-MM-DD text and compared as text, so ranges, year end and leap day hold; a workout is dated by its start day; snoozes and demo dates use the shared day-adding helper. App not opened for months: a forgotten workout auto-pauses after an hour with no sets and Finish offers the last tick as its end; following a plan again restarts its weeks from today. Plus ending (plan end) and moving phone are known faults reused; erase leaves settings behind (known). Gym pauses or closes, member leaves and returns, staff leaves and trial end are not decided in this area (no gym or plan logic in these folders).

New-only fixes looked for: the moved-import memory only covers workouts moved after the fix (finding). Others reach existing users: the history index and record repairs run on every start-up, and settings changes run a one-time update for every install.

Older workouts with no routine link fall back to matching by name; older workouts with no name keep their day type. Moved imported workouts get a path only on the same day (same name and length), none across days.

Rule applied: one new finding. Noted, not a finding: the settings update turned 'Show In use after sets' back on for every install, including members who had switched it off, by the owner's choice (3 Nov 2026).

This area holds no What's new, dot or update mark. Its one tip (muscle tips) waits until the plan has run 14 or more days, so a brand-new member sees none; the rest-alert ask is asked once per install.
Rule applied: no new mark on old things found in this area.
